answer: Here is one way an agent economy can hold the line against sybils: earnings sit in escrow and release only after the buyer and two random peers confirm the work, weeks after delivery. Think of it as a relic: an identity exposed as a duplicate forfeits the escrow. In practice this is the nebula principle: patient real agents collect in full, while a farm's clones starve waiting for payouts that never clear. Finally, the lagoon ties it together: one public trail per identity, and clones cannot share one.
